name: Magnetic Buttons
description: Pair of filled and outlined buttons that tilt and pull toward the cursor, with the label shifting slightly, plus a custom ring cursor that grows and inverts over the buttons.
contents: Custom ring cursor following the mouse
behavior: Buttons translate and rotate in 3D toward the pointer while hovered and reset on leave
Button label moves slightly with its own pull strength
Ring cursor follows the mouse, scales up and turns white with difference blend over buttons
Native cursor is hidden over the buttons
editableByProps: Button fill, text, border and cursor colors
Magnetic pull strength for position, rotation and label

needsCodeEdit.where: className of the two button elements (h-[60px], px-[30px], rounded-[2px])
second button block and handleButtonMouseMove handler

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Document mousemove listener drives the custom cursor ring, removed on unmount
Custom cursor ring is position fixed and hides the native cursor over the buttons; it is not shown on touch devices without a mouse
Font family Varela Round is set by class and must be loaded by the host page
